questions.solution:
If a and b are positive numbers and a2 > b2, it means a will also be greater than b.

So, in this case we will take square of the each given surd and then compare their values.

As we know that (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

(√32 + √17)2 = 49 + 2√544 ... (1)

(√24 + √25)2 = 49 + 2√600 ... (2)

(√39 + √12)2 = 51 + 2√468 ... (3)

(√17 + √24)2 = 41 + 2√408 ... (4)

Since, √600 is greater than √544, √468 and √408, and (2) has the same base value (49) as (1) but a larger added term 2√600, (2) will be the largest.

Thus, the greatest expression is √24 + √25.

Express method

When the sum of the given terms is the same, then the difference between the terms of that option is smallest, will be the greatest among given options.

Here,

option a: difference = 32 - 17 = 15

option b: difference = 25 - 24 = 1

option c: difference = 39 - 12 = 27

option d: difference = 24 - 17 = 7

Hence, option b will be the greatest.

questions.question: Which among the following is the largest? निम्नलिखित में से कौन सबसे बड़ा है?
questions.solution:
As we know, (a + b)(a - b) = a2 - b2

From option (1):

(√108 + √101)(√108 - √101) = 108 - 101 = 7

(√108 - √101) = 7/(√108 + √101)...(i)

From option (2):

(√86 + √79)(√86 - √79) = 86 - 79 = 7

(√86 - √79) = 7/(√86 + √79)...(ii)

From option (3):

(√217 + √210)(√217 - √210) = 217 - 210 = 7

(√217 - √210) = 7/(√217 + √210)

From option (4):

(√99 + √92)(√99 - √92) = 99 - 92 = 7

(√99 - √92) = 7/(√99 + √92)

Here, we can see that denominator of (iii) > (i) > (iv) > (ii), i.e,

(√217 + √210 ) > (√108 + √101) > (√99 + √92) > (√86 + √79)

And, (√217 - √210 ) < (√108 - √101) < (√99 - √92) < (√86 - √79)

Hence, (√86 - √79) is the largest.

Express Method

If the difference of a given number is approximately the same, then the pair whose number is greatest will be the smallest, and vice-versa the pair with the smallest number will be the largest.

Hence , option 2 is the largest.
